Field player v4 · the event is locked, the look moves

Keys: Space play/pause · X randomise look · T tap tempo · 1–5 modes · K S H F mute voices · R restart.

Every frame comes from the seed, the look and the step number, never the clock, so exports are identical every time and loop without a seam. A look code gives the same look on any machine.
